snippet.title: Aliens, Plasma Guns & Chewing Gum - Atari 2600 Homebrew
snippet.description:
An ancient alien race only mentioned in the Necronomicon has arrived at our doorstep and started abducting people from around the globe. Humankind is threatened and our only real hope of defeating the enemies is a specially trained group of soldiers with a peculiar taste for advanced weaponry and green glowing chewing gum.

Defend the planet from the ancient aliens in this fast paced shooter with lots of firepower for the Atari 2600 .

Developed by Ketil Ronne
Download: https://magovinna.itch.io/aliens-plasma-guns-chewing-gum
Also nominated for "Atari 2600: Best Homebrew Graphics (Original)" at the 7th Annual Atari Homebrew Awards over at AtariAge.
